pois.name: Empire State Building
pois.description: Art Deco triumph at 443m (102 floors), completed in 1931 in 410 days. Observatory on floor 86 is the most visited paid attraction in the US.

pois.name: Chrysler Building
pois.description: William Van Alen's 1930 Art Deco pinnacle (319m). Its eagle gargoyles and Nirosta steel spire, assembled in secret inside the crown, define the Manhattan skyline.

pois.name: Grand Central Terminal
pois.description: Reed & Stem's 1913 Beaux-Arts cathedral of transit. The Main Concourse ceiling is painted with a 2,500-star constellation map in cerulean blue.

pois.name: St Patrick's Cathedral
pois.description: James Renwick Jr's 1879 Gothic Revival cathedral, flanked by Rockefeller Center. The rose window is 26 feet in diameter — the largest decorative one in America.

pois.name: Rockefeller Center
pois.description: 14-building Art Deco complex (1930–39). Top of the Rock observatory offers the only view that includes the Empire State Building. The iconic Christmas tree since 1931.
